methods.summary: The study measured morphological traits (body length, inter-tegular distance, leg lengths, and proboscis length) on bee individuals, and floral traits (corolla length, corolla opening diameter, and sugar content) on flowers of non-crop plants.

discussion.summary: The study measured the relationship between bee visitation and various floral traits, such as corolla length, corolla diameter, and nectar sugar concentration, across an unspecified number of bee species and flower types.
